answer.worked:
The asymptotes give $y=\dfrac{a}{x-\frac12}-1$.

Using $(0,2)$:
$$\begin{align*}2&=\frac{a}{0-\frac12}-1\\a&=-\frac32\end{align*}$$
Hence
$$\begin{align*}y&=-\frac{3}{2x-1}-1\\y&=-\frac{2x+2}{2x-1}\end{align*}$$
At $x=-1$, the numerator is zero and the denominator is nonzero, confirming the other labelled intercept.
